3.9K views · 159 reactions | NIGER TAKES BACK ITS URANIUM. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?

For more than 50 years, French company Orano operated uranium mines in Niger.

Now Niger has taken major steps to reclaim control of those resources, including nationalizing Somaïr in June 2025.

But the bigger question remains: can Niger turn ownership into prosperity for its people?

Taking back control is only the beginning. The real victory will be measured by what ordinary Nigeriens gain.

8.5K views · 600 reactions | THE URANIUM THAT LIT FRANCE — WHILE NIGER STAYED IN THE DARK

For decades, uranium from Niger helped power France.

According to Oxfam, one in three light bulbs in France was once powered by Nigerien uranium. Yet approximately 90% of Nigeriens lacked electricity.

Africa has supplied the resources that fuel other people's prosperity for far too long. The question is no longer simply what lies beneath our soil. It is who benefits from it.

Africa must not simply supply the world. Africa must benefit, too.
